messages.subject: How to simulate multinormal distribution?
parts:
Hi all,
I'm new to TMB. We are working on spatio-temporal model of the population distribution for which i've already derived the mean and the variance-covariance matrix. Now i would like to simulate a multinormal distribution which take account for these parameters (mean and variance-covariance matrix). But unfortunately, I get an error message. Here is my code 
###################################################
library(mvtnorm)
simul_logN <- function(T,S,r,sigma_0,sigma,Rho,gamma,Lat, Long){
      #check that Rho <= 1 and that gamma <= 1 
      while ((Rho > 1) | (gamma > 1)){
              stop('Rho or gamma is greater than 1. Please do check it.')
      }

      #matrix variance-covariance of sigma
      sigma1 = matrix(0,nrow=S,ncol=S,byrow = T)
      for (Sample1 in 1:S){
            for (Sample2 in 1:S){
                  sigma1[Sample1,Sample2] = (Rho^sqrt(((Long[Sample1] - Long[Sample2])^2)
                                    +(Lat[Sample1]-Lat[Sample2])^2))
            }
      }   

      #set up logk matrix
      logk = matrix(0,nrow=S,ncol=T,byrow = T)
      logk[,1]<-rmvnorm(1, mean = rep(0, nrow(sigma1)), sigma = sigma1*sigma_0^2*sigma^2,
                          method=c("eigen")) #equilibrium population size at t=0
        for (t in 2:T){
              logk[,t] <- logk[,(t - 1)] + r
        }


      ##Simulating logN
      logN = matrix(0,nrow=S,ncol=T,byrow = T)
      logN[,1] <- rmvnorm(1, mean = logk[,1], sigma = sigma1,
                        method=c("eigen")) #equilibrium population size at t=0
      for (t in 2:T){
            u<-rmvnorm(1, mean = rep(0,nrow(sigma1)), sigma = sigma^2*sigma1,
                      method=c("eigen"))
            logN[,t]<-logN[,(t-1)]+u-0.5*sigma^2-gamma*(logN[,t-1]-logk[,t-1])
      }
      as.vector(logN)
}

nS = 4
nT = 4
LandSize= c(10,10)
Lat  = runif(nS) * LandSize[1]
Long = runif(nS) * LandSize[2]

logN = simul_logN(T=nT,S=nS,r=runif(1,0,10),sigma_0=0.2,sigma=0.6,Rho=0.8,
                  gamma=0.5,Lat=Lat,Long=Long)

S = rep(1:nS,nT)
T = rep(1:nT,each=nS)

distance= as.matrix(dist(cbind(Lat,Long),method="euclidean"))

x1 = rnorm(nS)



#####Code TMB
library(TMB)
rjnoasymp <- "
// Rhodes et Jonsen non asymptotic
#include <TMB.hpp>
template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() ()
{ //Datas
  DATA_VECTOR(logN);
  DATA_IVECTOR(T);
  DATA_INTEGER(nT);
  DATA_INTEGER(nS);
  DATA_IVECTOR(S);
  DATA_MATRIX(dist);
  DATA_VECTOR(X); //X is ecological variable that logK0 depend on deterministically
  
  //Parameters
  PARAMETER(slopelogk0);
  PARAMETER(interceptlogk0);
  PARAMETER(r);
  PARAMETER(logsigma);
  PARAMETER(logitgamma);
  PARAMETER(logsigma_0);
  PARAMETER(logitRho);

int t;
int s;
vector<Type> meanepsilon(nS*nT);

int Sample1;
int Sample2;
matrix<Type> Cov(nS*nT,nS*nT);

Type sigma=exp(logsigma);
Type gamma=1/(1+exp(-logitgamma));
Type sigma_0=exp(logsigma_0);
Type Rho=1/(1+exp(-logitRho));
Type res=0.0;
Type lg=log(1-gamma);
Type s2lg=((sigma*sigma)/(1-exp(2*(lg))))
Type logR=log(Rho)

//meanepsilon 
for(s in 1:nS){
  for(t in 1:nT){
    meanlogN[s+(t-1)*nS] <- interceptlogk0 + slopelogk0 * X[s]+r*t - (r + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * ((1-(exp(t * (lg))))/gamma );
  } //assumption: logN0 center on logK0 (equilibrium population at logarithm scale; c=0)
}

//variance-covariance matrix
// asumption:epsilon_i_0 have the same spatiale correlation structure with u_i_0
for(s in 1:nS){
  for(t in 1:nT){
  Cov[s+(t-1)*nS,s+(t-1)*nS]<-s2lg*(exp(2*t*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  
  }
  for(t1 in 1:(nT-1)){
  for(t2 in (t1+1):(nT)){

  Cov[s+(t1-1)*nS,s+(t2-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((t2-t1)*(lg))*(exp(2*t1*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  Cov[s+(t2-1)*nS,s+(t1-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((t2-t1)*(lg))*(exp(2*t1*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  }
  }
  }
  
 for(s1 in 1:(nS-1)){
 for(s2 in (s1+1):(nS)){
  for(t in 1:nT){
  Cov[s1+(t-1)*nS,s2+(t-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((distance[s1,s2]*logR))*(exp(2*t*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  Cov[s2+(t-1)*nS,s1+(t-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((distance[s1,s2]*logR))*(exp(2*t*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  
  }
  for(t1 in 1:(nT-1)){
  for(t2 in (t1+1):(nT)){
  Cov[s1+(t1-1)*nS,s2+(t2-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((t2-t1)*(lg))*exp((distance[s1,s2]*logR))*(exp(2*t1*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  Cov[s1+(t2-1)*nS,s2+(t1-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((t2-t1)*(lg))*exp((distance[s1,s2]*logR))*(exp(2*t1*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  Cov[s2+(t1-1)*nS,s1+(t2-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((t2-t1)*(lg))*exp((distance[s1,s2]*logR))*(exp(2*t1*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  Cov[s2+(t2-1)*nS,s1+(t1-1)*nS]<-s2lg*exp((t2-t1)*(lg))*exp((distance[s1,s2]*logR))*(exp(2*t1*(lg))*(sigma_0*sigma_0-1)+1)
  }
  }
  }
  }

 using namespace density;
 MVNORM_t<Type> your_dmnorm(Cov);
 res = your_dmnorm(logN-meanepsilon);
 return res;
}
"
cat(rjnoasymp,file="rjnoasymp.cpp")
tmp=compile("rjnoasymp.cpp",flags="-Wl,-V &> results.txt")
dyn.load(dynlib("rjnoasymp"))


### set up DATAs in list format  dans ModelDataTMB 
ModelDataTMB <- list(Y=logN,T=T,S=S,nT=nT,nS=nS,dist=distance,X=x1)

#### set up initial values to the parameters using function 
ModelInits <- function(){  
    slopelogk0     <-rnorm(1,0,0.1)
    interceptlogk0 <-rnorm(1,0,1)
    r              <-rnorm(1,0,0.1)
    logsigma       <-rnorm(1,0,1e-6)
    logitgamma     <-rnorm(1,0,1)
    logsigma_0     <-rnorm(1,0,1)
    logitRho       <-rnorm(1,0,1)
    list(slopelogk0=slopelogk0,interceptlogk0=interceptlogk0,r=r,logsigma=logsigma,
          logitgamma=logitgamma,logsigma_0=logsigma_0,logitRho=logitRho)
}          
set.seed(1)
parameters.s1 <- ModelInits()

#### TMB function on R :
obj_CMP <- MakeADFun(ModelDataTMB, parameters.s1, random=NULL,DLL = "rjnoasymp",silent=TRUE)
